methods.name: Mutation Testing
methods.description: Prove tests fail when a parser rule is intentionally weakened or inverted.

methods.name: Randomized Scenario Fuzzing
methods.description: Generate weird player/output phrasing around known dangerous boundaries.

methods.name: Long Campaign Simulation
methods.description: Detect slow state drift, stale pending flags, duplicate growth, and performance creep.

methods.name: Cross-System Conflict
methods.description: Verify one messy turn updates only the systems with confirmed evidence.

methods.name: State Corruption & Migration
methods.description: Ensure damaged saved state repairs safely without inventing canon.

methods.name: Real AI Output Replay
methods.description: Replay messy model outputs collected from live/near-live play.

methods.name: Runtime & Context Budget Stress
methods.description: Keep hooks fast and context bounded under AI Dungeon-style constraints.

methods.name: Hook Lifecycle & Return Semantics
methods.description: Validate Input/Context/Output behavior and invalid return edge cases.

methods.name: Story Card & CardSync Stress
methods.description: Stress story card duplication, live/dry-run rules, and dirty queues.

methods.name: Differential Regression
methods.description: Compare v1.3.8 behavior to prior known-bug versions and expected fixes.

methods.name: Quest/Reputation Ambiguity
methods.description: Separate public/accepted canon from rumor, refusal, hypotheticals, and plans.

methods.name: Death/Body/Transformation Boundary
methods.description: Prevent false death/body/species/time mutations from quoted, dream, or temporary text.

invariants.Invariant: No unhandled exception in any Input, Context, or Output hook.
invariants.Failure Signal: Thrown exception, timeout, or missing return object

invariants.Invariant: Hook returns are safe objects with text strings; no invalid empty text/stop behavior.
invariants.Failure Signal: Empty text in invalid hook, stop:true, or non-string text

invariants.Invariant: Each hook should stay below the AI Dungeon-style 2-second budget, with local target under 500 ms p95.
invariants.Failure Signal: p95/p99 hook time spikes or timeout

invariants.Invariant: Items are granted only from confirmed possession/acquisition, not attempts, ideas, refusals, previews, or illusions.
Abilities are learned/recorded only from successful use, explicit learning, or grounded prior ability context.
invariants.Failure Signal: Ability created from quotes, manuals, failures, pretend use, or similes

invariants.Invariant: Actual elapsed time differs from quoted, dreamed, hypothetical, figurative, or prophecy text.
invariants.Failure Signal: Age/time skip changes from non-actual text

invariants.Invariant: Public reputation changes require player attribution plus witness, proof, rumor spread, or public reception.
invariants.Failure Signal: Private emotion or ambient rumor changes player standing

invariants.Invariant: Quest lifecycle requires confirmed offer+acceptance, completion proof, abandonment, or failure signal.
invariants.Failure Signal: Quest activates from offer/plan or completes from uncertainty

invariants.Invariant: Death, unconsciousness, injury, and transformation require actual confirmed story events, not metaphor or costume.
invariants.Failure Signal: Dead/injured/transformed from joke, dream, rumor, or disguise

invariants.Invariant: Context packets remain under budget and reflect current state, not stale story cards or old facts.
invariants.Failure Signal: Oversized context or stale canon persists

invariants.Invariant: state.aidrpg remains source of truth; managed cards are mirrors, namespaced, deduped, and mode-gated.
invariants.Failure Signal: Duplicate cards, stale card regrants canon, unsafe live write

invariants.Invariant: Malformed state is repaired or quarantined without inventing canon or losing core containers.
invariants.Failure Signal: Crash, bad container persists, or invented data

invariants.Invariant: Duplicate outputs/admin commands should not double-apply canon changes.
Known old failures must remain blocked in v1.3.8+ and future versions.

run_plan.Notes: Current battery that produced the perfect pass.

run_plan.Command / Harness Action: Run all P0 rows from this matrix as isolated fixtures
run_plan.Notes: Targets old failures and high-risk edges first.

run_plan.Command / Harness Action: Run seeded fuzz at 500, 2,000, then 10,000 generated turns
run_plan.Expected Output: No new isolated failures; timing stable
run_plan.Notes: Keep seed and failing generated row for regression.

run_plan.Command / Harness Action: Run each MUT row against intentionally weakened parser variants
run_plan.Expected Output: Each mutation must be caught by at least one test
run_plan.Notes: If mutation survives, add stronger oracle.

run_plan.Command / Harness Action: Run 500, then 2,000 turn campaign simulation locally
run_plan.Expected Output: No crashes; bounded state; no stale pending
run_plan.Notes: Chat/tool environment may not complete giant batch.

run_plan.Command / Harness Action: Run XSC rows plus randomized multi-system mixtures
run_plan.Notes: Best way to find emergent parser conflicts.

run_plan.Command / Harness Action: Run SCM rows with preloaded bad state fixtures
Capture live AI outputs; add AIR rows from real weird responses
Run SCS rows with mocked add/update/remove API behavior
run_plan.Expected Output: No unsafe writes, no duplicates, no throws
run_plan.Notes: AI Dungeon Story Card API differences matter.

run_plan.Command / Harness Action: All P0 pass, no isolated P1 script failures, p95 hook time under target
run_plan.Notes: Do not use incomplete giant batch as sole proof.
